mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS suspectId, s.name, s.role_name AS roleName, CASE WHEN COUNT(q.id) = COUNT(ih.question_id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isInterrogationCompleted FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN suspects s ON s.case_id = gs.case_id LEFT JOIN questions q ON q.suspect_id = s.id LEFT JOIN interrogation_history ih ON ih.question_id = q.id AND ih.session_id = gs.id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.role_name, s.display_order ORDER BY s.display_order

SELECT s.id AS suspectId, s.name, s.role_name AS roleName, s.initial_statement AS initialStatement FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN suspects s ON s.case_id = gs.case_id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId} AND s.id = #{suspectId}

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.question_text AS questionText, CASE WHEN ih.question_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isAsked FROM questions q LEFT JOIN interrogation_history ih ON ih.question_id = q.id AND ih.session_id = #{sessionId} WHERE q.suspect_id = #{suspectId} ORDER BY q.display_order
